SYFY

Ringfall

Two hundred years after the first colony ships left Earth, a salvage pilot on a dead moon finds a ring that was never supposed to exist. Every government in the system wants her silent before she can say where it points.

sci-fi · 3 seasons, 18 episodes · art-12.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 Salvage Rights 58 min
    Ines Varga tows a derelict hauler off Callisto and finds a passenger who has been dead for two centuries.
  • S1 E2 The Quiet Ring 52 min
    The hauler's log points to a structure in orbit around Uranus that no chart has ever shown.
  • S1 E3 Tariff 49 min
    A Belt union inspector boards the salvage ship and discovers the cargo is worth more than the ship.
  • S1 E4 Burn 51 min
    A Martian frigate matches course. Ines has nine hours of fuel and one lie left.
  • S1 E5 Protocol Seven 50 min
    Earth's intelligence service wakes a sleeper on Ceres whose only job is to make the ring go away.
  • S1 E6 Perihelion 61 min
    The ring opens for the first time in two hundred years, with three navies watching.
  • S2 E1 Other Side 55 min
    The crew wakes on the far side of the ring under a star that has no name.
  • S2 E2 Dead Reckoning 48 min
    With no charts and failing water, the ship follows a signal that answers in their own voices.
  • S2 E3 The Colony 53 min
    A settlement of the lost first fleet is still here, and it has been expecting them.
  • S2 E4 Founders' Day 50 min
    The colony's governor offers Ines a seat at the table. The price is her ship.
  • S2 E5 Escape Velocity 52 min
    Mars sends a second expedition through, and the colony closes its gates.
  • S2 E6 Homeward 60 min
    Ines carries the colony's only message back to a solar system that has already declared war.
  • S3 E1 Blockade 54 min
    Earth and Mars seal the ring. The Belt decides it is tired of asking permission.
  • S3 E2 The Lantern 50 min
    A second ring lights up near Neptune and the balance of power tips in a day.
  • S3 E3 Chain of Command 49 min
    A mutiny aboard the Martian flagship puts Ines in a room with the admiral who hunted her.
  • S3 E4 Tidal 51 min
    The rings begin to move, and the orbits of three moons move with them.
  • S3 E5 What the Ring Wants 53 min
    The colony governor returns with an offer that would end the war and the human species' independence with it.
  • S3 E6 Ringfall 64 min
    Ines makes the one choice every navy agreed she would never be allowed to make.

Ember Hollow

Every autumn the forest outside Ember Hollow lights up from the inside, and every autumn someone walks in to find out why. This year it is the sheriff's daughter, and this year the lights are answering back.

horror · 2 seasons, 12 episodes · art-06.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 First Light 46 min
    Sheriff Dale Okafor finds a hunter's truck idling at the tree line with the heater on and nobody inside.
  • S1 E2 The Stag 44 min
    Nell Okafor photographs a deer standing in front of a light that casts no shadow.
  • S1 E3 Burn Line 45 min
    The forestry service maps the glow and finds it moving a hundred yards closer to town every night.
  • S1 E4 Mrs. Teller's Boy 47 min
    A man who vanished in the 1991 autumn walks out of the trees, exactly as old as the day he left.
  • S1 E5 Cold Ash 44 min
    The town council votes to close the forest road. The forest opens a new one.
  • S1 E6 Hollow 52 min
    Nell walks in, and for the first time the lights go out behind her.
  • S2 E1 Spring 46 min
    Six months on, the forest is dark and Nell is back, but she will not say where she has been.
  • S2 E2 The Survey 44 min
    A mining company's geologists arrive with a permit and a map of something buried under the hollow.
  • S2 E3 Kindling 45 min
    Fires start in three homes on the same night, each one in a child's bedroom, none of them with a child inside.
  • S2 E4 The Returned 48 min
    Everyone the forest ever took walks back into town on one afternoon, and none of them are hungry.
  • S2 E5 Firebreak 46 min
    Dale tries to burn the hollow out before the mining company can dig it up.
  • S2 E6 What Walks Back 54 min
    The lights return early, and this time they come as far as Main Street.

The Drowned Court

Beneath the lake lies a kingdom that drowned a thousand years ago and never stopped ruling. Two sisters from the shore town are summoned to serve at its court, and only one of them is meant to come back up.

fantasy · 2 seasons, 12 episodes · art-04.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 The Summons 50 min
    On the night of the spring tide, a rowan branch washes up at the Marlowe sisters' door with their names cut into the bark.
  • S1 E2 Below 47 min
    Wren and Ada descend and find a court that speaks their language as it was spoken a thousand years ago.
  • S1 E3 The Berry Tithe 46 min
    Every servant of the court must eat from the rowan. Wren refuses and the lake begins to rise over the town.
  • S1 E4 The Queen's Mirror 48 min
    Ada is chosen as the drowned queen's reflection and starts forgetting the shape of the sun.
  • S1 E5 Low Water 49 min
    A drought on the surface exposes the court's spires, and the shore town comes down with boats and hooks.
  • S1 E6 One Comes Up 56 min
    The sisters learn which of them the court intends to keep, and make their own choice instead.
  • S2 E1 Shore Leave 49 min
    Wren returns to a town that has aged thirty years in the week she was gone.
  • S2 E2 The Drowned Prince 47 min
    A boy from the court walks the shore road in daylight, and the water follows him.
  • S2 E3 Salt 46 min
    The lake turns to brine overnight and the court's old enemy, the sea, sends an envoy.
  • S2 E4 Ada 50 min
    Ada rules the court as queen, and her first decree is a war on the surface.
  • S2 E5 The Rowan Pact 48 min
    Wren bargains with the sea to break the court's hold, and the price is every memory she has of her sister.
  • S2 E6 Still Water 57 min
    The lake goes flat and silent for the first time in a thousand years. Something beneath it is listening.

Feedback

An anthology of hauntings that travel through the things we plug in. Each season follows one signal from the first flicker to the last person left watching.

horror anthology · 2 seasons, 12 episodes · art-08.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 Scan 44 min
    A library archivist digitising old family photos finds a face in the scanner bed that is not in the print.
  • S1 E2 300 DPI 43 min
    Every copy of the scan is different, and every copy is closer.
  • S1 E3 The Negative 45 min
    The archivist traces the photo to a 1970s portrait studio whose clients all died within a year of sitting.
  • S1 E4 Flatbed 42 min
    The scanner starts running on its own, and the output tray is never empty in the morning.
  • S1 E5 Exposure 44 min
    A security guard who watched the footage of the archive wakes with a stranger's mouth.
  • S1 E6 Last Copy 51 min
    The archivist destroys every scan but one, and keeps it where no one would look: her own face.
  • S2 E1 Dial Tone 44 min
    A late-night radio host takes a call from a listener who died on air in 1983.
  • S2 E2 Dead Air 43 min
    The station's transmitter starts broadcasting a show that is not on the schedule.
  • S2 E3 Call-In 45 min
    Listeners across the county report the same voice telling them to leave their doors open.
  • S2 E4 Frequency 44 min
    An engineer isolates the signal and finds it is coming from the host's own apartment.
  • S2 E5 Request Hour 42 min
    The caller asks for one song, and every radio in the county plays it at once.
  • S2 E6 Sign-Off 50 min
    The host reads the final sign-off from a script she did not write, in a voice that is not hers.

Veil

A grief counsellor discovers that the thin place between the living and the dead runs straight through her own house. The dead have been trying to get her attention for years. Now they have it.

horror · 1 season, 6 episodes · art-11.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 Frosted Glass 46 min
    Dr. Maren Holt notices a handprint on the inside of her shower door and no one has used the bathroom in days.
  • S1 E2 Intake 44 min
    A new client describes Maren's house room by room. He has never been there. He died in 2009.
  • S1 E3 The Wall 45 min
    Maren finds the previous owners' records: six families, six years, six missing persons.
  • S1 E4 Session Notes 44 min
    The voices on her session recordings are not her clients'.
  • S1 E5 Thin 47 min
    The veil wears through in the kitchen, and something on the other side reaches all the way in.
  • S1 E6 Through 53 min
    Maren crosses over to bring one of the missing back, and learns why the house chose a counsellor.

Homemaker

A 1950s housewife who cannot die, cannot leave the house and cannot stop smiling. The knives in the kitchen wall are from the last husband. The pie is for the next one.

dark comedy · 1 season, 7 episodes · art-03.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 Cherry 31 min
    Dolores bakes for the new neighbours, who are the fourth family to move in since 1957 and the first to ask about the smell.
  • S1 E2 Spring Cleaning 30 min
    A realtor arrives to list the house. Dolores explains, politely, that the house is not for sale and neither is she.
  • S1 E3 The Tupperware Party 32 min
    Dolores hosts the street, and every guest leaves with leftovers and a small, permanent gap in their memory.
  • S1 E4 Husband Number Six 30 min
    A door-to-door salesman proposes by accident. Dolores accepts on purpose.
  • S1 E5 Rhubarb 31 min
    A detective investigating the previous five husbands is invited to stay for dinner, and then for good.
  • S1 E6 Thanksgiving 33 min
    Dolores sets a place for everyone she has ever lost, and they all come.
  • S1 E7 Pie Crust 36 min
    The house finally offers Dolores a way out. She has to decide whether she wants one.

Last Town Standing

Twelve strangers are dropped into a rebuilt frontier town with no money, no law and a cash prize buried somewhere under Main Street. Last one holding the deed wins. Everyone else walks out of town on foot.

genre reality · 1 season, 8 episodes · art-07.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 Stagecoach 42 min
    Twelve players arrive with one dollar each and the saloon is already charging five for a room.
  • S1 E2 The Bank Job 42 min
    The first alliance forms over a plan to rob the town bank, which the producers built with a real safe.
  • S1 E3 High Noon 42 min
    A duel challenge (paintball, ten paces) decides who keeps the sheriff's badge and the key to the jail.
  • S1 E4 Gold Rush 42 min
    A rumour about the prize location sends half the town digging up the schoolhouse floor.
  • S1 E5 Wanted 42 min
    The town votes to exile its first player, and she leaves with the only map.
  • S1 E6 Dry County 42 min
    The saloon runs out of water. The general store owner becomes the most powerful person in town.
  • S1 E7 Land Grab 42 min
    A land auction forces every remaining player to show how much cash they have actually been hiding.
  • S1 E8 The Deed 58 min
    Three players, one deed, and a buried prize that turns out to be under the only building no one dared dig up.

Whiteout

Eight riders, one mountain, seventy-two hours of storm. A survival competition filmed above the treeline, where the forecast is the only producer that matters.

genre reality · 1 season, 6 episodes · art-13.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 Drop Zone 42 min
    Eight riders are helicoptered to a ridge at 3,400 metres with a board, a shovel and a bivvy each.
  • S1 E2 Cornice 42 min
    The first descent crosses a cornice that the mountain guide refuses to certify.
  • S1 E3 Front 42 min
    The storm arrives twelve hours early and the riders dig in on the wrong side of the ridge.
  • S1 E4 Pit 42 min
    A snow pit test splits the group: half ride the face, half wait it out.
  • S1 E5 Flat Light 42 min
    A whiteout wipes the horizon and one rider's beacon goes silent.
  • S1 E6 The Line 56 min
    The storm clears for one hour, and the last three riders race a single untouched line to the valley.

USA

The Long Dry

1934. The rain has not come to Carver County in three years. A rider arrives carrying a bank's money and a preacher's name, and the town has to decide which one to believe.

prestige drama · 2 seasons, 12 episodes · art-01.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 Dust 57 min
    Silas Reed rides into Carver with a satchel of bank notes and a sermon nobody asked for.
  • S1 E2 The Grange 54 min
    The farmers' cooperative votes to withhold the harvest, and the bank's men arrive the same night.
  • S1 E3 Tithe 52 min
    Silas preaches a sermon on debt that empties the church and fills the grange hall.
  • S1 E4 Foreclosure 55 min
    The sheriff serves the first eviction of the season, and a widow's barn burns before he reaches it.
  • S1 E5 Strike 53 min
    The county's wheat stays in the silos. The bank hires a man from Chicago to change that.
  • S1 E6 Rain 61 min
    The first storm in three years breaks over a town already on fire.
  • S2 E1 Ledger 55 min
    Silas's real name reaches Carver in a newspaper two weeks old.
  • S2 E2 The Chicago Man 53 min
    The strikebreaker builds his own congregation out of the men the grange turned away.
  • S2 E3 County Line 52 min
    A neighbouring county's sheriff rides in with a warrant and leaves without his badge.
  • S2 E4 Harvest 54 min
    The wheat finally moves, under armed guard, to a buyer no one in town has met.
  • S2 E5 Confession 55 min
    Silas tells the truth from the pulpit, and the town has to decide whether the truth changes anything.
  • S2 E6 West 63 min
    The bank wins the county. Silas rides out at dawn with less money and more followers than he arrived with.

Pale Street

A disgraced forensic accountant works cold financial crimes for a city police unit that does not officially exist. Every case starts with money that went somewhere it shouldn't, and ends with someone who wishes it hadn't been found.

procedural · 3 seasons, 18 episodes · art-02.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 Shell 44 min
    Theo Marsh is offered a desk in a basement with no name on the door and a 1998 embezzlement nobody closed.
  • S1 E2 Wire 43 min
    A charity's missing endowment traces to a hat shop that has not sold a hat in twenty years.
  • S1 E3 Float 44 min
    A dead bookmaker's ledger names half the precinct, and Theo has to choose which half to report.
  • S1 E4 Escrow 43 min
    A property deal that closed the day before a fire leads to a city councillor's brother-in-law.
  • S1 E5 Round Trip 44 min
    The money from Theo's own conviction resurfaces in an account that was opened last week.
  • S1 E6 Balance 50 min
    The unit's commander is the one name Theo has not run, and the only one still on the street.
  • S2 E1 Audit 44 min
    Internal Affairs finds the basement. Theo has one day to make the unit look like it never existed.
  • S2 E2 Numbered 43 min
    An offshore account with a nine-digit balance belongs to a man who has been dead for a year.
  • S2 E3 Dividend 44 min
    A pension fund's quiet collapse turns out to have been planned by its own retirees.
  • S2 E4 Kiting 43 min
    A chain of cheques across six banks points to a courier who only works Sundays.
  • S2 E5 Cash Basis 44 min
    Theo's old firm offers him his licence back in exchange for one file.
  • S2 E6 Write-Off 50 min
    The unit's commander trades Theo for his own clean exit, and Theo lets him think it worked.
  • S3 E1 Reserve 44 min
    A new commander arrives with a budget, a name on the door and a list of cases she wants closed quietly.
  • S3 E2 Laundry 43 min
    A laundromat that takes in forty thousand dollars a week in quarters is the cleanest business in the city.
  • S3 E3 Co-Sign 44 min
    A student loan fraud ring is run out of a university's own bursar's office.
  • S3 E4 Arrears 43 min
    The hat shop from the first case reopens, and sells one hat, for a million dollars.
  • S3 E5 Settlement 44 min
    Theo is subpoenaed to testify against the one person who ever gave him a second chance.
  • S3 E6 Pale Street 52 min
    The street the unit is named for finally gives up what was buried under it.

Sandbox

A security engineer at the world's largest payments company finds a backdoor in code he wrote and does not remember writing. The person who did has his face, his passwords and a nine-month head start.

thriller · 2 seasons, 12 episodes · art-09.jpg / art-05.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 Commit 51 min
    Adrian Kell finds a commit under his name, dated a night he was in hospital.
  • S1 E2 Staging 48 min
    The backdoor has been live in production for nine months and has moved nothing. Yet.
  • S1 E3 Keynote 49 min
    Adrian's CEO announces the company's new identity platform on stage, built on the compromised code.
  • S1 E4 Two-Factor 50 min
    Someone logs in as Adrian from his own apartment while he watches from across the street.
  • S1 E5 Rollback 48 min
    Adrian tries to revert the code and discovers every backup has the same change.
  • S1 E6 Root 56 min
    The other Adrian makes contact, and the message is a list of everything the real one has ever done.
  • S2 E1 Fork 50 min
    The company goes public with Adrian's double as its chief security officer.
  • S2 E2 Cold Storage 48 min
    A forgotten data centre in Nevada holds the first copy of Adrian's identity, and it is still running.
  • S2 E3 Breach 49 min
    The backdoor finally fires: one cent from every account on Earth, in one second.
  • S2 E4 Disclosure 50 min
    Adrian takes the story to a journalist whose byline has been his double's since March.
  • S2 E5 Privilege 48 min
    A board vote decides which Adrian keeps the company. The other keeps the access.
  • S2 E6 Sandbox 58 min
    Adrian builds a copy of the whole system to trap his double, and finds himself already inside it.

Slow Burn

A fire investigator returns to the apartment block she grew up in, the week before it is condemned. Every tenant remembers the night it burned differently, and one of them remembers her.

prestige drama · 1 season, 6 episodes · art-10.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 Notice to Vacate 56 min
    Lena Castellanos takes a routine condemnation inspection and recognises the stairwell from a night she has spent twenty years not remembering.
  • S1 E2 Fourth Floor 52 min
    A tenant who has not left her apartment since 2004 keeps a box of the fire's original evidence.
  • S1 E3 Accelerant 53 min
    The original report named faulty wiring. The wiring was replaced the week before.
  • S1 E4 The Super 54 min
    The building's superintendent is the same man, and he knows exactly which apartment Lena lived in.
  • S1 E5 Smoke 52 min
    The city moves the demolition forward, and Lena finds out who signed the order.
  • S1 E6 Point of Origin 60 min
    Lena stands in the apartment where it started and finally remembers who lit the match.

The Summer People

Two kids from a lake town fall for each other the summer the tourists stop coming. Their families have fought over the shoreline for forty years and are not about to stop for them.

dramedy · 1 season, 6 episodes · art-14.jpg
Episodes
  • S1 E1 Memorial Day 44 min
    The lake's biggest resort closes for good, and Juno Bell and Cal Whitaker are the only two people under thirty left in town.
  • S1 E2 The Dock 43 min
    A dock built an inch over the property line restarts a feud that has outlived two grandfathers.
  • S1 E3 Regatta 44 min
    The town's annual boat race goes ahead with four boats, two of them owned by people who are not speaking.
  • S1 E4 Off Season 43 min
    A developer offers both families the same number, and only one of them says no.
  • S1 E5 Fireworks 44 min
    Juno and Cal are found out on the Fourth of July, in front of the whole town, in the only boat that still floats.
  • S1 E6 Labor Day 52 min
    The lake drops a foot, the old property line reappears, and nobody is where they expected to be.
